node.statement: Because Q is one-dimensional it is nonvanishing by one-dimensional-projection-nonvanishing; compressed-product-display therefore makes u_Q the unit of its O(e)-C*-corner, so the registered unit norm axiom yields a universal C_u and threshold with | ||u_Q||-1|<=C_u e. Combining this with node 1.1.1 and ||q_T(X)^2*u_Q||=q_T(X)^2||u_Q||, choose a universal e_q>0 so that (1/2)||X||<=q_T(X)<=2||X|| for every n and every amplified column X.
